_about: Reference faces for tools/imgqa_scene.py: several per person, CCIP-matched against every face in a scene render. Public references only (art/approved, game3d portraits). More references, and the private-only people, are in island/private/rewards/tools/imgqa-cast.json (git-ignored, same shape, merged in when it exists; the tool finds the main checkout from a worktree). glasses = what this person wears in every picture. only_in: the person is only looked for in files whose path has one of those words. thresh: a person's own thresholds over THRESH in tools/imgqa_scene.py (Eric's approved portrait is ink-style and the renders are not, so his distances run higher); cost_bonus is taken off his distance when picking who is who for a face with stubble. A reference 'file#1' is the second biggest face of a picture. hair_refs: the references the hair colour is measured on. hair_check false: not checked (cap, no approved look).
